# The Luxe Jewels

> The Luxe Jewels (also called Luxe Jewels) is an Indian online jewellery brand at https://www.theluxejewels.in. We sell anti-tarnish, waterproof 18k gold plated fashion jewellery for everyday wear — earrings, necklaces, bracelets, rings, and gift sets. Ops are in Noida / Delhi NCR. We ship prepaid orders pan-India.

## Identity

- Official name: The Luxe Jewels
- Also known as: Luxe Jewels, Luxe Jewels Noida, The Luxe Jewels India
- Website: https://www.theluxejewels.in
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theluxejewels.in_/
- Type: Online jewellery store (fashion jewellery with 18k gold plating — not solid / hallmarked gold)
- Founded: 2024
- Languages: English, Hindi

## What we sell

Lightweight anti-tarnish jewellery made for Indian weather — humidity, commute, office, and light festive wear. Finishes are waterproof for daily life and skin-safe / hypoallergenic.

- Earrings: https://www.theluxejewels.in/earrings
- Necklaces: https://www.theluxejewels.in/necklaces
- Bracelets: https://www.theluxejewels.in/bracelets
- Rings: https://www.theluxejewels.in/rings
- Full shop: https://www.theluxejewels.in/shop
- Gifts under ₹499: https://www.theluxejewels.in/gifts/under-499
- Navratri edit: https://www.theluxejewels.in/festive/navratri
- Diwali edit: https://www.theluxejewels.in/festive/diwali

## Buying

- Offer: Buy 2 Get 1 Free on paid pieces
- Free shipping on prepaid orders over ₹1000
- Payments: prepaid only (UPI, cards, net banking via Razorpay). No cash on delivery.
- Returns: unused items within 10 days of delivery
- Typical delivery: 3–7 business days after dispatch, pan-India
